📌I went to this dental clinic. A warning to everyone!!!

✳️The doctor's name is Sarisa Na Songkhla. She didn't explain why X-rays were necessary for dental work, but insisted on them at 250 baht per sheet. Easy, isn't it? Dental treatment doesn't require much skill; it's all about the patient's money. When I asked why X-rays were necessary, she told me to go to another doctor. I was upset about the X-rays and said it wasted my time, since I had an appointment. She then told me I was late, and that she was wasting her time. I apologized for being late when I entered the room. Her time is money, a business!

It's ridiculous! If she's so rich, why doesn't she just stay home? And this clinic even has doctors who drive patients away like this!
